name: Ojou-sama wa Chijoku no Ejiki
source:
Many years ago his family's business was seized in a hostile takeover and his parents passed away. Now a struggling college student, Shiro (protagonist) meets the privileged heiress of that hostile company, and decides to take revenge. He deceptively draws close to her and blackmails her with a secret to make her do shameful things... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE077495.html]DLSite English[/url]]
